messages:
taylor: shared a new mock for the eval onboarding + compact-diff tweaks: https://www.figma.com/file/new-eval-onboard (onboarding-modal, compact-diff, flagging) fran: nice! first pass: onboarding CTA reads 'See how evals work' too vague. suggest action-first: 'Run a demo eval' or 'Try a guided eval' so users know they'll trigger something. mina: UX: the compact-diff micro-interaction collapses details into a hover-only affordance which is inaccessible on touch. propose persistent chevron affordance (visible) and a dedicated keyboard target. olga: accessibility note: contrast on the "Flag" pill (light orange on white) fails at 12px. also screen readers announce the diff row as 'link' due to the entire row being clickable; we should expose separate controls (Primary action: Select, Secondary: Open) and use role="button" for non-link elements. design-bot: automated scan: 3 contrast failures (flag pill, tiny timestamp, legend text), missing aria-label on 'Mark reviewed' checkbox. See /reports/scan-1855123456.pdf fran: copy for review flow: current CTA is 'Mark reviewed' but I worry it's ambiguous if it closes the run. Maybe 'Mark as reviewed (keeps in run)' vs 'Approve and archive' for stronger actions. keep Mark reviewed idempotent and reversible. taylor: good call. Proposed microcopy: primary action = 'Approve and archive' (dangerous/big), secondary = 'Mark as reviewed' (non-destructive). inline toast for Mark reviewed: 'Marked as reviewed Undo'. mina: keyboard nav: implement roving tabindex on rows and make space/enter either toggle selection or expand depending on a setting (space to select, enter to expand). add `.` (dot) shortcut to toggle 'show only new regressions'. document in keyboard help. olga: aria-live suggestion for the onboarding: when the guided eval starts, announce 'Guided eval started. Progress: 0%.' then update to 'Guided eval completed' with role="status" and polite. prevents screen reader silence. design-bot: accessibility checklist appended to ticket UX-4533: contrast fixes, aria-labels, roving tabindex, aria-live onboarding. fran: onboarding flow question: do we auto-create a demo prompt-set or let users pick one? Auto-creating is simpler but could pollute their workspace. maybe create a transient demo prompt-set flagged "demo" that auto-deletes after 7 days. show a clear banner: 'This demo prompt-set is temporary.' taylor: agree transient demo set is good. also add an option: 'Save this prompt-set' during the post-run summary. copy: 'Save this prompt-set for repeat runs' with link icon. mina: compact-diff performance note: expanding many rows in a large run bogs the client. suggest virtualized expansion and lazy-load annotation data. also merge duplicate network calls when opening multiple rows quickly. olga: audit/logging note: any 'Approve and archive' action needs to include reason optional field for enterprise customers. include 'action_context' with run_id + diff_ids in audit entry. security/prod-ops should sign off. prod-ops-bot: heads-up: retention policy requires export events and approval actions to be stored for minimum 90 days for enterprise plans. tagging security for retention confirmation. fran: microcopy for flagging: current label 'Flag' is terse. consider 'Flag for follow-up' and subtext 'Notifies collaborators and creates a ticket'. small gray text helps set expectation. taylor: could also add quick actions inside the diff: 'Flag -> create ticket' which opens mini modal with prefilled title 'Follow-up: ' and optional assignee. keeps flow fast. mina: accessibility small: add visually-hidden text for the flag count badge: '3 flagged diffs' to avoid ambiguity for screen readers. and ensure badges are at least 14px. olga: mobile pattern: avoid two-tap confirm for flagging; use a long-press to open quick actions, and keep single-tap for inline toggle. ensure there's focus state so keyboard users can still access quick actions. design-bot: added tickets: UX-4533 (onboarding + aria-live), UX-4534 (compact-diff performance + virtualization), UX-4535 (flagging microcopy + modal), FE-730 (roving tabindex + keyboard shortcuts), SEC-210 (audit retention). taylor: action items: fran update Figma with demo-set banner + CTA copy (#UX-4533), mina prototype virtualized expansion and keyboard mapping (#UX-4534/#FE-730), olga draft accessibility notes and aria labels (#UX-4533), i'll sync w/ security on audit fields (#SEC-210) and add cards to the sprint. fran: draft onboarding CTA suggestion: 'Try a guided eval' with secondary 'Explore docs'. I'll add microcopy variants in Figma. mina: added a small code snippet for aria-live we can reuse: ```
Guided eval progress: 0%
``` olga: uploaded contrast swatches and suggested token `--badge-flag` darker stop to Figma. left comments on compact-diff frame. design-bot: reminder: include undo for mark-reviewed toast and include 'Save prompt-set' CTA in post-run summary per UX-4533. taylor: thanks team. i'll open the PR outlining the copy choices and keyboard help doc. ping me if you want to pair on the virtualization prototype. :thumbsup:
